title: Divergence: thermite-lower sep_fn (count_sep/sep_free) u8 separator coercion keeps the textual ends_with('as u8') heuristic #231 removed elsewhere AND drops the #122 inner paren on a Binary arg — 'sep + 1 as u8' = int, E0308, L0 death on correct source

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_sep_fn_arith_arg_paren.rs::count_sep_arith_separator_arg_parenthesizes_before_u8_cast. req count_sep(s, sep + 1) == 0 emits __thermite_count_sep(s.data@, sep + 1 as u8) = sep + (1 as u8) = spec int into sep: u8 — verus E0308 live-confirmed. Authority: 07-strings.md REQ-15 (sep cast as u8) + #122 paren discipline. Expected: (sep + 1) as u8. Note: the surface has no u8 type, so the ends_with('as u8') skip-arm can only match generated text; the live killer is the missing paren.
